python命令更新电脑的火狐 - request Python commands to update Firefox on Windows
Method 1: pip install mozilla-tools then mozinstall.install('firefox', 'latest')
Method 2: requests.get download Firefox installer from Mozilla URL, save to C:/Temp/FirefoxSetup.exe, subprocess.run with /S silent install
Method 3: winget upgrade Mozilla.Firefox or choco upgrade firefox -y
Method 4: complete automation - close_firefox() with psutil.process_iter, download to tempfile, subprocess.run with /S /MaintenanceService
pip install requests psutil wmi dependencies needed
Notes: run as administrator, stable network, backup data, Windows assumed
Simple method: subprocess.run(['firefox', 'about:about']) or maintenanceservice.exe update
python检查目前具有哪些软件 个版本 - request Python to check installed software and versions
Method 1: winreg.OpenKey HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE SOFTWARE uninstall paths to get DisplayName, DisplayVersion, Publisher
Method 2: wmi.WMI().Win32_Product() for Name, Version, Vendor, InstallDate
Method 3: platform-specific - Windows PowerShell Get-ItemProperty, Linux dpkg -l or rpm -qa, macOS system_profiler SPApplicationsDataType
Method 4: get_specific_software_version with subprocess.run for python, node, java, git, docker, pip, firefox, etc.
查询火狐浏览器版本 - request Python methods to query Firefox browser version
Method 1: subprocess.run(['firefox', '--version']) parse output for version
Method 2: get_firefox_version_windows check multiple paths like C:/Program Files/Mozilla Firefox/firefox.exe with --version
